parameters: (You see the ship's sick bay robot in front of you, amid hospital beds, a surgury station, and medical equipment.)\LB

(The bot is capable of providing a variety of services, including selling healing and curative potions and other products.  They do come at a price, and the robot is enchanted in that it somehow magically gets more supplies in exchange for gold from time to time, due to it's enchantment and design by the ship manufacturer which makes a profit with everything the robot sells.)\LB
(You can heal party members in-between conversations with them, using the menu screen as always.)
Price Factor: How expensive the "Inn" is.
Temporary 3: Chance in tenths of a percent of attack, interrupting sleep.
\$(You see your personal bunk, with it's comfy blue blanket, ready and waiting for you in your personal quarters.)\LB

(You can try to sleep for the night if you wish.  If no monsters or other enemies attack the skycraft while you and your companions all sleep, the rest will restore Health Points and heal all members the same as a town's Inn will.  There is however a chance that the skycraft will come under attack, in which case you and your party will be pulled into battle instead of getting healed.)\LB(The skycraft is currently flying in skies that are not the safest.)\LB

(Resting aboard the skycraft will cost you \V[10] \G, which pays for food, laundry, utilities, healing therapies, and supplies and such, collected by onboard enchanted robots and magically teleported to the skycraft's manufacturer.  The payment is collected for each rest attempt regardless of whether or not you get any rest or get attacked by monsters.)\LB
